02 · FLAGSHIP PROJECT

AgriBridge

Connecting farmers directly to buyers — an AI-powered agricultural marketplace, built with a 6-person team.

🌾 AgriBridge
Business & Technical Proposal

A mobile marketplace that removes unnecessary middlemen between smallholder farmers and buyers — wholesalers, retailers, hotels, supermarkets, and consumers. Farmers get real-time market prices, digital pickup scheduling, and transparent payments; buyers get fresh produce with traceability back to the farm. What sets it apart from a basic listing app is the AI layer: price prediction, photo-based quality grading, and demand forecasting that turn the app into a decision-support tool, not just a catalogue.

FARMERRegisters, checks price, uploads produce photos, requests pickup
→
ADMIN / COMPANYAssigns vehicle, confirms pickup, pays farmer fairly
→
BUYERBrowses produce, orders, tracks delivery, rates
Price PredictionForecasts crop prices from historical trends so farmers know when to sell.
Quality GradingGrades produce photos A/B/C to support fairer pricing.
Demand ForecastingPredicts regional crop demand to guide planting and selling.
GPS PickupFarmers pin their farm so pickup vehicles navigate directly to the field.
Bilingual UIFull Tamil & English support for regional accessibility.
Open MarketplaceEvolves from single-buyer model into a commission-based multi-buyer platform.
PHASE 1 · MO 1–3

MVP: registration, pricing, listings, pickup requests, single-buyer model.

PHASE 2 · MO 4–6

Online payments, order tracking, ratings, AI price prediction.

PHASE 3 · MO 7–9

Open marketplace with verified multi-buyer, best-buyer recommendation.

PHASE 4 · MO 10–12

Quality grading, demand forecasting, expand regions & crops.
